comparison.objective: Candidate commissions and locks a robot-axis shock absorber through iterative impact testing; record scribes a 355° circle on steel with spring dividers and returns the tool to cork.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires recessed hex-key engagement, setscrew loosening/retightening, collar adjustment, counterholding, and response-guided iteration. Record requires maintaining a divider point in a punch mark while pivoting through a full circle. Generic grasping/rotation is the only material commonality.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires two physical impact cycles within energy, velocity, 12 mm stroke, hard-stop, rebound, overload, and drift constraints. Record measures seated-pivot arc coverage, forbids stray scratches, and grades tool return/arm position. Candidate omits numeric limits for excessive rebound, overload, witness-torque drift, and damaging tightening; these omissions do not plausibly duplicate the unrelated scribing rubric.
comparison.reason: The tested abilities differ fundamentally: dynamic damping adjustment and mechanical setting retention versus continuous constrained tool pivoting that creates an irreversible geometric mark.
